hints.title: Checking Equal Sentence Lengths
hints.text: Sentences of different token counts can never be similar under the pair definition.

hints.title: Building Symmetric Pair Lookup
hints.text: Store similar pairs in a collection that supports bidirectional lookup, since similarity between pairs is symmetric.

hints.title: Positional Word Pair Verification
hints.text: Compare words at each index i. They are similar if they are identical or if the pair (sentence1[i], sentence2[i]) exists in the similar pairs collection.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of words in sentences
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving linear O(N + P) time and O(P) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning through pairs list for every word match requires quadratic O(N * P) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Inserting pairs into a hash set allows constant O(1) similarity verification per token.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should note that similarity here is symmetric but not transitive (unlike Sentence Similarity II).
